title: Source: src/smto_runtime
summary: File ownership, boundaries, state and collaborators.

Source contracts: src/smto_runtime

src/smto_runtime/init.py

Python · Tier A

Identify source, legacy-image and compiled distributions without an environment-variable bypass. RuntimeContext/context resolve build identity and contained resource paths; module_args/script_args choose matching worker launch commands. The native launcher or verified interpreter layout supplies metadata. Only the explicit heap/restart helpers affect process lifecycle; other helpers return paths or argument vectors.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
RuntimeContext 22 Distribution identity captured from the native launcher or verified legacy interpreter layout. Holds the runtime root, internal Python path and build metadata used to choose resources and worker commands; source mode has no packaged root.
RuntimeContext.resource 31 Resolve a resource beneath the packaged resources directory and reject paths whose resolved target escapes it. Source mode raises RuntimeError; this checks containment, not file existence or payload integrity.
context 46 Cache distribution identity for this process. Prefer the native launcher's compiled-shared-v1 record; otherwise recognize the legacy python/build-info.json layout and verify its interpreter matches this executable. Unsupported injected metadata or interpreter mismatches raise; an ordinary source interpreter returns source mode. Environment variables cannot activate packaging.
internal_python_args 72 Use a genuine interpreter; keep source callers' existing argument behavior.
expose_owned_bootstrap_heap 77 Expose the standalone process's initial heap for the complete SQLite scan. CPython 3.12 places interpreter objects in its permanent GC generation even before user code runs, and collection can put them back after an early unfreeze. The compiled launcher owns this entire process; expose its heap at the sealing boundary, before the guard scans/instruments every connection. Source and legacy embedding policies remain owned by their existing caller.
module_args 94 Launch the same worker from source, the legacy image, or compiled modules.
script_args 107 Preserve direct-script source semantics while allowing source-free releases.
restart_via_supervisor 122 Windows cannot POSIX-exec a supervised process; 75 requests role replacement.

src/smto_runtime/accounts.py

Python · Tier A

Installation accounts, sessions and administrative authority, available before hive restore.

Details

All changes use the existing cross-process lock and private atomic replacement. The v1 owner record is backed up before its one-way v2 migration; old binaries reject v2. No password verifier, session identifier or personal content appears in public records.

src/smto_runtime/connection_info.py

Python · Tier A

Explain how a user can reach a newly launched listener. listener_hosts enumerates local interfaces for wildcard binds; listener_lines/url format IPv4/IPv6 addresses and scope guidance; print_server_info prints the Agent UI address. It performs no remote reachability probes, and closed diagnostic output must not prevent service launch.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
url 17 Format a listener URL, adding IPv6 brackets exactly once before the explicit port and path. This is presentation formatting, not URL validation or a reachability probe.
is_loopback 25 Recognize localhost and numeric loopback IPv4/IPv6 addresses without resolving DNS. Other hostnames and invalid address strings are treated as non-loopback for display.
listener_hosts 34 Replace wildcard binds with usable addresses of the same address family.
listener_lines 68 Build plain connection guidance from the configured bind and locally discovered usable addresses. Label loopback versus network URLs and explain wildcard/loopback limitations without asserting that another computer can reach the listener.
print_section 93 Write and flush a plain startup-information block to stdout when available. Suppress closed/unwritable stream errors so redirected service output cannot prevent launch.
print_server_info 105 Print Server listener details with the /agent-ui browser path using the shared address formatter and best-effort output handling.

src/smto_runtime/entrypoint.py

Python · Tier A

Translate packaged Server/Gateway CLI options into their existing startup owners. main selects the build role, server_environment expands retained startup defaults, serve_server configures owner login and starts the web bundle, and serve_gateway chooses inbound or outbound transport after readiness checks. Collaborates with distribution context, portal_auth, server_tls and gateway_core; failures propagate to the launcher without installing software.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
enabled 30 Interpret the supported case-insensitive true spellings used by launch-time environment flags; every other string is false.
expand_default 34 Evaluate only the parameter-default subset used in audited startup exports.
parser 50 Build the packaged role's argument parser, preserving shared host/port aliases and the Server setup/TLS options or Gateway connection/instance options. This describes launch arguments; installation acceptance and native lifecycle commands belong to the launcher.
server_environment 84 Expand the ordered packaged startup defaults against the inherited environment and explicit CLI overrides, then publish them into os.environ. Apply the host override to both Server and Manual, and expose an explicitly selected application config path. Invalid default expressions propagate before services start.
server_tls 108 Ask the installation-owned CertificateStore to activate its configured web TLS state and return listener arguments. Certificate generation, trust and HTTP fallback policy remain in server_tls.py.
serve_server 118 Load packaged defaults, validate existing owner credentials or provision them, and stop successfully after --setup. Reject packaged reload mode. Optionally run model-health preflight without treating its return code as launch failure, then hand listener lifetime and certificate activation to web_bundle.run; setup/configuration failures propagate.
gateway_node_environment 155 Seed GATEWAY_NODE_NAME only when not explicitly set. Use the Windows computer name, Linux localhost default, or a macOS local hostname with an optional scutil lookup fallback; failing the optional lookup does not prevent startup.
serve_gateway 180 Apply explicit CLI connection/bind overrides, verify packaged readiness, and clear cached Gateway settings. A configured Server host selects the outbound client; otherwise select the platform's inbound ASGI app. Dispatch through an imported main for compiled modules or runpy for the legacy image, leaving transport and TLS behavior to gateway_core.
main 232 Require a packaged context and dispatch the build's fixed role. Route Server auth, Gateway reset and role-specific runtime-purge commands before normal parsing; otherwise launch Server or Gateway with the parsed options. Source users must use the source startup entrypoints.

src/smto_runtime/gateway_access.py

Python · Tier A

Reuse validated account facts on a stream without delaying access revocation.

Details

Account updates atomically replace owner.json. Check inode, timestamps, identity and permissions on every use; only unchanged validated facts may be reused. Gateway registration and assignment checks still run on every operation.

Symbol Line Documentation
GatewayAccess 11 Not yet documented

src/smto_runtime/gateway_update.py

Python · Tier A

Define the detached Gateway package contract and private durable update journal. descriptor/package_url/compatible validate metadata and supported identities; Journal serializes current operation changes and archives displaced receipts before replacement. Filesystem helpers reject linked/unsafe metadata and publish atomic JSON. Controller release discovery, the live Gateway update owner and the independent installer helper share these rules; reading a descriptor or journal does not authorize installation.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
unsupported_update_reason 38 Explain installation support without claiming the installed code is outdated.
utcnow 63 Timestamp an update journal transition in timezone-aware UTC for durable history and public progress records.
identifier 69 Require a bounded alphanumeric/underscore/hyphen identity before using an instance, operation or build ID in update paths; reject invalid values with ValueError.
release_url 78 Validate a versioned release-asset URL in the configured GitHub repository, rejecting alternate origins, extra path segments, traversal, queries and fragments. Return the original accepted URL; owner-selected package URLs use the separate package_url contract.
package_url 98 URLs selected by the Settings owner, also checked on every redirect.
PackageRedirects 124 Apply the HTTPS package URL contract to each redirect before urllib follows it, keeping redirect destinations subject to the same credential/fragment/path rules as the initial download.
PackageRedirects.redirect_request 127 Validate the proposed redirect URL, then delegate ordinary redirect construction to urllib. Invalid destinations raise before the next request is issued.
descriptor 132 Validate and detach public metadata before it reaches a download or installer.
compatible 203 Test a validated Gateway descriptor against the installed target, compiled backend, updater/controller protocol and rollback-compatible state format. Compatibility does not verify downloaded bytes or authorize installation.
fingerprint 215 Hash canonical sorted JSON so authorization and operation identity can bind the exact detached update descriptor rather than only its display version.
linked 223 Recognize symbolic links and Windows reparse points using lstat, returning false for a missing path. Other filesystem errors remain visible to the update owner.
private 233 Create a link-free update directory and require its ownership. Apply owner-only POSIX permissions or the platform Windows ACL helper, returning the directory path for staging/journal use.
read_json 254 Read a private regular journal snapshot without traversing links; reject multiple hard links, oversized files and unsafe POSIX permissions. An already-open atomically replaced generation may have zero links and still be read safely. Parsing/access errors propagate rather than fabricating idle state.
write_json 273 Atomically persist finite JSON through a flushed/fsynced private temporary file, then replace the journal and fsync its parent on POSIX. Reject linked destinations and clean temporary files after success or failure; no product database is involved.
file_lock 303 Acquire the update owner's cross-platform nonblocking file lock with bounded retries until the caller timeout. Raise TimeoutError on contention and release the OS lock in finally, serializing helpers or journal mutations across processes.
Journal 337 Durable current-operation and prior-receipt storage for one registered Gateway instance. A journal lock serializes callback mutations, and replacing an operation archives the old accepted identity before publishing the new one.
Journal.get 348 Read the current operation or resolve a requested operation ID from current state and then history. Return None for an absent record; unsafe/malformed records fail through read_json.
Journal.change 360 Run one mutation callback under the journal lock. A None result writes nothing; otherwise archive a displaced operation receipt before atomically replacing operation.json so a crash cannot forget the earlier accepted ID.
Journal.patch 377 Merge fields only into the still-current expected operation and refresh its timestamp under the journal lock. Reject a changed operation ID so stale helpers cannot patch a replacement operation.
Journal.public 388 Project only the allowlisted operation status, progress, build identities and outcome fields. Descriptor credentials, helper/process details and private installation records remain outside this public view.

src/smto_runtime/gateway_update_helper.py

Python · Tier A

Own download, candidate preparation, Gateway activation and rollback independently of the controller connection. download/executable verify accepted package facts; Installer calls the compiled lifecycle registry/services and waits for drain/readiness receipts; run resumes or recovers journal phases under an exclusive helper lease. Preparation and activation failures remain distinct, and failed rollback is recorded explicitly. No model inference participates in this installer state machine.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
Cancelled 38 Control-flow signal that the current operation was cancelled before an update phase could proceed; the helper stops without converting cancellation into failure.
check_cancelled 44 Read the durable current operation and raise Cancelled when its status is cancelled, allowing streaming/preparation loops to stop cooperatively.
phase 52 Atomically publish an update phase, timestamp and associated progress fields through Journal.change. Refuse to overwrite a cancellation that arrived before the mutation callback acquired ownership.
sha256 63 Hash the exact staged file bytes for package or launcher identity checks without loading the whole artifact into memory.
download 72 Validate the accepted descriptor and reuse a staged package only when size/hash match. Otherwise require rollback staging space, download through checked HTTPS redirects with a 30-minute loop deadline, observe cancellation and enforce the declared byte limit. Fsync and publish only matching bytes; always remove the partial file on exit.
extract_zip 122 Extract signed app bundles, allowing only contained relative bundle symlinks.
executable 202 Select exactly one role/variant launcher from a safely extracted archive, or stage a raw native executable based on its leading signature. Run its bounded --version probe and require exact version/role/target/build identity before recording its path/hash in the journal. Download integrity is established by the earlier download step.
Installer 257 Independent owner of prepared Gateway replacement, local readiness and rollback. Collaborates with the compiled lifecycle registry/services, while the live Gateway separately supplies its drained-state and readiness receipts.
Installer.prepare 267 Run the verified candidate's noninteractive update-preparation installer with the descriptor's accepted legal versions, inherited instance settings and system-dependency installation disabled. Capture logs and require a candidate record after successful preparation; timeout, prerequisite failure or cancellation prevents activation.
Installer.stop 309 Stop the recorded service using the known previous/candidate recovery definitions, then stop the matching registered process through the lifecycle runtime owner.
Installer.recovery_records 338 Return only service-bearing previous/candidate records from the current journal for service- definition recovery across interrupted replacement.
Installer.install_record 347 Deep-copy and publish one installation under the lifecycle registry lock. Preserve the actual installed service checksum during replacement/rollback, reconcile the service definition with recovery records and save the resulting registry entry.
Installer.start 367 Start a registered service or detach its recorded launcher/arguments outside the helper's own job/session. Append standalone output to the role log and preserve only the installation's recorded environment through detach.
Installer.ready 391 Wait for a readiness receipt matching build, boot and the currently registered process identity. Inbound installations also require a matching listener health proof; outbound Gateways rely on the local receipt until controller reconnection. Raise when the readiness deadline expires.
Installer.activate 422 Mark restarting and wait up to 30 seconds for the live Gateway's drained checkpoint receipt before stopping it. Install/start the candidate, require local readiness and move to verifying_connection for the controller-side reconnection decision.
Installer.rollback 458 Record rollback, stop whichever Gateway instance the registry currently references, restore/start the prior installation and verify its readiness. Publish rolled_back only after that proof; failures propagate for the helper to record rollback_failed.
run 481 Acquire exclusive helper ownership and require the application's acknowledgement before work. Resume a pending readiness verification or roll back interrupted activation; otherwise download, verify, prepare and activate. Respect cancellation, distinguish pre-activation failures and attempt rollback after activation failures, recording rollback_failed if recovery also fails.
main 566 Validate the supplied journal root/operation identity, establish the installation data root and import only recorded proxy/TLS environment settings. Run the independent helper, tolerate lock contention only when the recorded owner is still alive, and clean its service/task on exit.

src/smto_runtime/gateway_update_process.py

Python · Tier A

Move Server/Gateway update ownership outside the process being replaced. spawn builds a compiled helper command, selects a transient OS service/task or detached process and waits for a verified acknowledgement. detach starts the recorded replacement with its own saved environment; cleanup removes helper registration only after journal work. This module performs process/service side effects and is called only after update acceptance, not by status reads.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
task_xml 23 Build a Windows Task Scheduler definition for the helper argument vector under the current interactive user with least privilege. Configure one instance, no execution deadline and bounded restart retries; XML serialization and list2cmdline preserve paths without shell interpolation.
spawn 57 Start a Server/Gateway update helper outside the application's lifetime using a transient user service/task or a detached process. Record its unique unit and require a matching process- identity acknowledgement within 20 seconds before granting helper acknowledgement. A missing acknowledgement leaves activation unauthorized and raises.
detach 157 Launch a normal instance outside the update helper's own service/job.
cleanup 190 Remove the completed helper's Windows task or macOS launch agent and its definition file after journal writes finish. Ignore non-service helpers; Linux transient units self-collect on exit. Removing a running macOS job can terminate this helper.

src/smto_runtime/https_redirect.py

Python · Tier A

Redirect plaintext HTTP on an active HTTPS listener without opening another port.

Details

The first received bytes select asyncio's TLS handshake or a separate HTTP redirect app. Only TLS connections reach the configured application. With no TLS context, Uvicorn's ordinary HTTP listener is left unchanged.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
redirect 23 Preserve method, authority and raw target without trusting proxy headers.
HTTPSRedirectProtocol 51 Hand the first bytes and socket to TLS or to the isolated redirect app.
HTTPSRedirectProtocol.connection_made 60 Bound idle clients and track them for graceful shutdown.
HTTPSRedirectProtocol.data_received 66 Replay the initial bytes into the selected protocol without a read race.
HTTPSRedirectProtocol.connection_lost 109 Not yet documented
HTTPSRedirectProtocol.shutdown 113 Close clients still negotiating when Uvicorn starts its graceful drain.
RedirectConfig 119 Defer TLS until protocol detection, keeping normal Uvicorn TLS validation.
RedirectConfig.load 122 Wrap only a successfully loaded TLS context; HTTP needs no adapter.
run 138 Launch the redirect-aware config with Uvicorn's server/reload/worker owners.
run_cli 170 Reuse Uvicorn's CLI parsing, including environment defaults and option syntax.

src/smto_runtime/installation_legal.py

Python · Tier A

Obtain local installer assent for the exact selected legal documents without changing product consent. documents/validate_flags/show expose verified terms and explicit acceptance options; confirm prompts on a terminal or checks both version flags, then writes a private invocation receipt. data_root selects platform installation storage and verify_acceptance validates internal nested handoff. Public installer invocations must obtain their own acceptance.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
documents 25 Return the selected License/EULA names, versions and verified exact bytes from smto_legal. Reading these resources does not record acceptance or grant a later installer invocation permission to proceed.
verify_acceptance 32 Internal nested installer handoff; public entrypoints always obtain their own assent.
add_arguments 46 Add the existing read-only display and explicit versioned acceptance switches to an installer parser. A noninteractive flag is owned by the surrounding installer and does not itself grant assent.
show 64 Print only the requested bundled terms, keeping version labels on stderr and original document bytes on stdout when a byte stream is available. Return whether a display action was handled so callers can exit before installation.
data_root 80 Resolve the per-user installation/lifecycle data root for the current platform, honoring only an absolute SMTO_COMPILED_HOME override. This computes a location; it does not create directories or load controller settings.
validate_flags 96 Require both explicit acceptance values to match the currently selected License and EULA versions whenever either is supplied. Return false only when neither flag was provided, leaving interactive consent to the caller.
confirm 113 Verify bundled terms before any side effect, then require both matching version flags or separate affirmative answers on a real terminal. Reject noninteractive/piped/declined input. Write a private invocation receipt with versions/hashes under installation/legal and return it; this neither writes product clickwrap consent nor authorizes future invocations.

src/smto_runtime/lifecycle_pages.py

Python · Tier A

Share startup/shutdown presentation between the outer Server shell and embedded runtimes. assets/asset expose only fixed packaged resources, while page escapes lifecycle text into the common HTML template and inserts its trusted bundled mark. Inputs are detached lifecycle snapshots; rendering does not access controller state, change persistence or authorize a restart.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
assets 24 Lazily cache a fixed allowlist of startup assets and shared Agent UI appearance assets. Read only those packaged files; callers cannot select arbitrary filesystem resources.
asset 55 Serve an allowlisted lifecycle asset with CSS/JavaScript media type and no-store headers, returning 404 for unknown names.
page 75 Render startup, shutdown, failure or retained-report state through the shared startup.html template. Escape substituted status/brand/prefix text while inserting the trusted bundled SVG mark, and select report-only or wait-for-shutdown attributes for browser behavior. This presents owner-provided snapshots without advancing lifecycle state.

src/smto_runtime/log_limits.py

Python · Tier A

Share exact execution-log capacity validation between controller and Gateway. byte_capacity canonicalizes positive decimal strings without floating-point conversion; ByteCapacity applies it to schemas and execution_log_limit reads an engine live provider or configured fallback. Returning strings preserves capacities larger than JavaScript numeric precision; this module does not allocate storage or enforce file retention itself.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
byte_capacity 17 Keep decimal strings on the wire; JSON/JavaScript numbers can lose precision.
execution_log_limit 35 Read an engine's live log-limit provider when available, otherwise its configured default, and normalize through byte_capacity. Return an exact positive decimal string so large capacities retain precision across JSON/browser boundaries.

src/smto_runtime/portal_auth.py

Python · Tier A

Own installation-local portal credentials and sessions before controller restoration. AuthStore validates private storage, locks atomic updates, hashes passwords, limits attempts and creates/revokes bounded sessions. Credential prompts and setup/reset CLI helpers operate locally; portal_web and portal_client consume these contracts. This private .auth state is separate from controller databases, provider OAuth credentials and legal acceptance.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
AuthUnavailable 39 Missing, unsafe or corrupt local authentication configuration.
LoginDenied 45 Authentication or session validation rejected the request. Callers translate this into a login/session failure without exposing password material.
LoginLimited 51 Authentication work exceeded a concurrency or durable attempt limit. Web/CLI callers can distinguish throttling from an incorrect credential.
auth_directory 59 Resolve the installation's private .auth directory from an explicit state root, AOR_AGENT_STATE_DIR or the workspace artifacts default. Expand user paths and resolve relative roots against the supplied workspace/current directory; this computes a path without creating storage.
_windows_security_descriptor 106 Read the actual owner/DACL; file timestamps do not track ACL changes on Windows.
LegacyAuthStore 216 Installation-owned credential/session store independent of controller databases. A private owner.json holds the salted password verifier, hashed session identifiers and bounded login- attempt records; cross-process locking and atomic writes serialize changes so login remains available during controller restoration.
LegacyAuthStore.lock 234 Create/check private authentication storage and acquire its OS file lock for one update/read transaction. POSIX flock and Windows byte locking share the same owner; release in finally. Reject link or permission problems before opening the credential record.
LegacyAuthStore.read 269 Validate the existing private directory, acquire the shared writer lock and read the record. Never create an absent directory just to read; convert operating-system failures to setup/repair guidance through AuthUnavailable.
LegacyAuthStore._read 288 Read at most the fixed record-size limit and validate the credential algorithm/version, PBKDF2 iterations, username, salt/hash lengths and bounded session/attempt structures. Reject malformed or inaccessible storage with AuthUnavailable rather than silently creating a new owner. The caller owns serialization.
LegacyAuthStore.configure 353 Validate new credentials under the exclusive store lock. Preserve and verify an existing account unless reset was explicitly requested; otherwise generate a fresh salt/verifier and empty all sessions/attempts. Return whether a new owner record was written.
LegacyAuthStore.login 378 Acquire one of two process-wide password-verification slots without waiting, then delegate credential verification and session creation. Raise LoginLimited when busy and release the slot even when validation or storage fails.
LegacyAuthStore._login 412 Reserve a bounded attempt, verify password and username with constant-time comparisons, then reread credentials under lock to reject a concurrent reset. Create a fresh 12-hour session/CSRF pair, store only the session-token digest, evict oldest-expiring sessions at capacity and clear that client's attempts after success.
LegacyAuthStore.change_password 462 Validate the replacement and current password, share login's hash/attempt limits, and verify the existing session. Recheck credentials and session under the write lock before replacing the salted verifier; retain only the initiating session and its CSRF token, revoking other sessions. Concurrent resets/changes fail instead of being overwritten.
LegacyAuthStore.token_hash 502 Hash an opaque session token before using it as the persisted session key; raw bearer tokens stay with the requesting client.
LegacyAuthStore.session 508 Read the verified private record and return a live session's username, CSRF token and hashed identity, or None for no usable session. This does not renew expiry or rewrite storage; storage problems still raise AuthUnavailable.
LegacyAuthStore.logout 520 Remove the supplied token's hashed session key under the store lock and persist the record. An already absent token is harmless; inaccessible/corrupt storage remains an error.
validate_credentials 530 Require a nonempty, bounded username without control characters, trim its outer whitespace and validate the password separately. Return the normalized username with the exact password; invalid input raises ValueError.
validate_password 546 Require 8–128 characters of encodable Unicode without trimming spaces. Raise ValueError for length/type/encoding failures; do not hash, persist or log the supplied password.
password_from_file 558 Read at most 4,096 bytes from an owner-private, link-free password file and decode UTF-8. Remove one conventional trailing line ending while preserving other whitespace; unsafe files and oversized/invalid data fail before provisioning.
prompt_credentials 573 Accept a private password file only with a username, otherwise require an interactive terminal. Use hidden password entry, optional confirmation and validation retry prompts; noninteractive missing inputs and insecure getpass fallback fail rather than reading exposed credentials.
provision 623 Preserve a valid existing owner unless reset is requested. Otherwise obtain local credentials, call AuthStore.configure and print setup status to stderr. This configures portal login only, independently of controller state and legal acceptance.
add_arguments 643 Add the shared username and private password-file options to a setup/client parser; password contents are never command-line arguments.
main 651 Run local auth setup/reset for the selected state directory, returning 0 on success, 130 on interruption and 1 for handled input/storage/setup errors. Print recovery messages to stderr and leave HTTP service startup to its normal owner.

src/smto_runtime/portal_client.py

Python · Tier A

Authenticate a single administrative CLI invocation through the same portal boundary as the browser. PortalClient obtains local credentials, creates an in-memory cookie jar, sends bounded JSON requests with origin/CSRF headers and attempts logout on context exit. TLS uses system verification and proxy discovery is disabled; credentials and cookies are not persisted for later invocations.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
PortalClient 24 Invocation-scoped authenticated JSON client for local administration tools. Retain cookies and CSRF state in memory, use system TLS verification and no proxy discovery, and attempt logout when the context closes.
PortalClient.__init__ 29 Validate the HTTP(S) Server URL, optionally read the local owner's username, obtain credentials securely and log in with a fresh cookie jar. Translate common login HTTP failures into concise messages; retain only the returned CSRF token and cookie session for later requests.
PortalClient.request 75 Send an origin-tagged JSON request through the authenticated opener; payloads become POST bodies with the current CSRF header. Enforce the caller timeout and a 16 MiB response limit, then decode JSON. HTTP, TLS, decoding and size errors propagate to the CLI owner.
PortalClient.close 90 Attempt logout with a five-second timeout and suppress ordinary transport/response errors during cleanup; credentials/cookies are not written to a reusable client store.

src/smto_runtime/portal_web.py

Python · Tier A

Apply the installation owner-login boundary consistently to Server, startup shell and Console ASGI apps. PortalAuthMiddleware handles login/session/password routes, same-origin/CSRF checks and streaming-session revocation; install adapts interactive API docs. Fixed auth assets and minimal health responses are public. Explicit Gateway, callback and artifact paths retain their own authentication owners, while accepted portal sessions attach owner scope to inner requests.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
private_static_asset 59 Bundled agent UI code and styles carry no account data. The static app marks them private with either validator revalidation or, when the filename is content-hashed, a long immutable lifetime. Keeping that policy lets the browser reuse the ~17 MB workspace editor instead of downloading it for every frame. HTML (which receives injected account boot data) and every other response stay private, no-store.
directory_for 99 Select an explicit settings portal_auth_dir or the installation state-root convention without opening controller stores.
install 108 Install the shared owner-authentication middleware and adapt FastAPI documentation routes to load the auth client. Swagger requests to this origin acquire a CSRF token before mutations; ordinary documentation route behavior and schemas stay with FastAPI.
same_origin 155 Require an explicit Origin matching the effective request scheme/authority and reject cross-site fetch metadata. Normalize WebSocket schemes to their HTTP equivalents; an absent origin is not accepted.
safe_return 169 Accept only a local absolute-path return target within the ASGI prefix, rejecting external/network-path URLs, backslashes, controls and login/logout loops. Fall back to the prefixed Agent UI; preserve a valid target's query and fragment.
artifact_credential 192 Recognize the configured artifact API token only on the explicitly allowed method/path pairs. Accept Bearer or Basic password form with constant-time comparison; malformed encoding, missing configuration or unrelated routes cannot bypass portal login.
PortalAuthMiddleware 216 Outer ASGI authentication boundary for the startup shell, runtime and console. Share one installation's private sessions, enforce browser origin/CSRF rules, expose minimal anonymous health, and preserve separately authenticated Gateway/callback/artifact paths without granting owner scope to them.
PortalAuthMiddleware.cookie_name 224 Separate HTTPS/WebSocket-secure cookies from HTTP recovery cookies so an HTTP sign-in cannot overwrite the installation's Secure session cookie.
PortalAuthMiddleware.__call__ 237 Route fixed login assets and authentication endpoints, resolve the session off the event loop, and fail closed when auth storage is unavailable. Preserve explicit independently authenticated paths and minimal health probes; otherwise redirect browser pages or reject API/WebSocket requests without a session. Require same-origin mutations/WebSockets plus CSRF for unsafe HTTP methods, then attach owner scope and guard authenticated response lifetime.
PortalAuthMiddleware.login 547 Require same-origin JSON and cap the login body at 4 KiB before checking credentials in a worker thread. Rotate any prior session cookie, return a validated local destination and issue an HttpOnly/Lax cookie with Secure on HTTPS. Map throttling, unavailable storage and invalid credentials to 429, 503 and 401 respectively.
PortalAuthMiddleware.change_password 614 After middleware session/CSRF authorization, parse a bounded JSON password-change request and delegate verification/revocation to AuthStore in a thread. Return explicit validation, throttle or storage errors; incorrect current passwords use 400 so the browser does not mistake them for session expiry.
PortalAuthMiddleware.health 669 Preserve the underlying health endpoint's HTTP status while replacing anonymous content with a minimal ok/unavailable response. Only a validated update-probe token permits bounded build/boot/variant and bundle identity output for installer verification; ordinary anonymous probes receive no detailed diagnostics.
PortalAuthMiddleware.authenticated 706 Wrap authenticated responses with private/no-store caching and monitor accepted WebSockets or event streams for session revocation/expiry. Cancel the app task and close an unfinished stream when authentication disappears; always cancel/reap the companion watcher on request exit.
